topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can’t stop thinking about the paper and how it started to feel like a dream, a dream where I was writing words that weren’t quite mine. Every time I thought I was back on track, I’d find myself veering off, pulling from places I shouldn’t have. Now, facing this, I wish I had the courage to look directly at the professor, to explain, to apologize, but my eyes find the floor instead. I know I should have studied harder, should have found a way to say what I wanted to say in my own voice. I just didn’t realize how much I’d lost my way until it was too late.
